title: Collapse navigation buttons into a dropdown menu

requirements.text: Replace the flat row of navigation buttons (Dashboard, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time) in the Dashboard with a single dropdown menu trigger. Clicking the trigger opens a dropdown listing all sections; selecting an item navigates to that tab and closes the dropdown.

quotes:
Can you put these buttons in a dropdown menu. Dashboard
Income
Expenses
Inventory
Customers
Sales
Attendance
Farm Time

acceptanceCriteria: A single dropdown trigger button is visible in place of the individual navigation buttons.
Opening the dropdown reveals all eight items: Dashboard, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time.
Clicking any dropdown item switches the active tab to the corresponding section.
The dropdown closes automatically after a selection is made.
The currently active section is visually highlighted in the dropdown list.
The dropdown is keyboard-accessible (open/close with Enter/Escape, navigate with arrow keys).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui.

Preserve all existing tab content components (SummaryTab, IncomeTab, ExpenseTab, InventoryTab, CustomersTab, SalesTab, AttendanceTab, FarmTimeTab, VerificationTab) — only the navigation trigger changes.
Admin-only Verification tab must remain hidden from non-admin users as before.
nonGoals: Changing any backend logic or data models.
Restructuring routing or adding new pages.
Adding new navigation items beyond those listed.
